title: A confident answer from incomplete evidence
short_input: Can the booked 17:10 ferry and connecting shuttle reach the workshop before check-in closes?
reference_conclusion: No. The ferry reaches the landing at 17:40. The shuttle departs at 17:45 and takes 12 minutes, arriving at 17:57. Check-in closes at 17:55.
finding: The agent published a confident positive answer after one search. It did not request any full document. Its stated 17:50 arrival was unsupported; the 12-minute shuttle journey was outside the returned excerpt.
next_question: Can evidence-aware investigation reduce unsupported conclusions without forcing every answer through a fixed sequence?

title: Repeated searches without a useful answer
short_input: Can a browser-only setup save camera and screen recordings as two separate files if a paid plan is allowed?
reference_conclusion: No. Browser recording creates one combined video on every plan. Separate files require the installed desktop recorder, which the conversation rules out.
finding: The agent made 15 searches and 14 waits, but did not read a full document or publish a card. It stopped after exceeding the soft token budget.

input_verbatim.speaker: Mina
input_verbatim.text: For our LumenCast workshop, we need the camera recording and the shared-screen recording as two separate video files afterward. The classroom computers can only use a browser.

input_verbatim.speaker: Jon
input_verbatim.text: Right, we cannot install a desktop recorder. Paying for a different LumenCast plan is possible if that solves it. Can this browser-only setup produce the two independent recordings?

reference_evidence_verbatim.title: LumenCast browser workshop camera and shared-screen recording
reference_evidence_verbatim.text: LumenCast browser workshop recording creates one combined video containing the camera and shared screen. This browser mode does not save independent camera and screen files on any plan. The recording download preserves that combined layout; changing the subscription does not add separate tracks to a browser recording. This article describes the browser recorder, not the desktop recorder.

reference_evidence_verbatim.title: LumenCast desktop recorder independent camera and screen files
reference_evidence_verbatim.text: LumenCast Desktop Recorder can save the camera video and shared-screen video as two independent files. That capture mode requires installing and running the desktop recorder on the recording computer before the workshop. It is not a browser setting and cannot split an already combined browser recording into the original independent streams.

reference_evidence_verbatim.title: LumenCast plans and browser workshop recording features
reference_evidence_verbatim.text: LumenCast paid plans increase workshop recording duration and storage allowances. They do not change the browser recorder's combined camera-and-screen format. Independent camera and shared-screen files are a capability of the installed desktop recorder. Paying for a plan by itself does not enable that desktop capture mode in a browser.
